workItems.objective: Define the provider-neutral WorkDependencyAnalysis artifacts, module surface, and proposal port.

included: Define candidate snapshot, dependency proposal, authoritative DAG, coverage, diagnostics, and baseline contracts.
Keep proposal providers outside Core-owned graph and policy authority.
excluded: Executing, assigning, scheduling, or estimating work items.

checks.method: Run positive and negative closed-contract fixtures.
checks.successCriteria: Only provider-neutral, planning-only artifacts and proposal-port operations validate.

required-evidence.description: Only provider-neutral, planning-only artifacts and proposal-port operations validate.

workItems.objective: Document WorkDependencyAnalysis configuration, trust boundaries, artifacts, outcomes, and extension points.

included: Explain native, optional adapter, Spec Kit reviewer, OPA, Graphology-DAG, Gate, and traceability responsibilities.
Publish the bounded V1 static-DAG limitations and downstream handoff.
excluded: Representing proposal hints as authoritative dependencies.

dependency-hints.rationale: Documentation should cite final verified behavior.

checks.method: Review documentation against the approved requirements, architecture, and release evidence.
checks.successCriteria: Operators can configure and audit the module without confusing proposal, authority, or execution boundaries.

required-evidence.description: Operators can configure and audit the module without confusing proposal, authority, or execution boundaries.

workItems.objective: Implement the WorkDependency Gate and exact authoritative DAG baseline promotion boundary.

included: Reject incoherent snapshots, unresolved proposals, missing edges, cycles, invalid ordering, unsafe parallel frontiers, and policy failures.
Promote only replay-verified candidate bytes and persist an atomic merge proof.
excluded: Executing the promoted DAG or assigning specialists.

deliverables.description: WorkDependency Gate and baseline promotion runtime.

checks.method: Run exact promotion, stale-byte, cycle, missing-edge, unsafe-frontier, and policy-denial fixtures.
checks.successCriteria: Only one complete replay-verified static DAG can become the authoritative dependency baseline.

required-evidence.description: Only one complete replay-verified static DAG can become the authoritative dependency baseline.

workItems.objective: Implement Core-owned static-DAG mechanics with Graphology-DAG.

included: Normalize vertices and edges, detect cycles and missing references, compute deterministic ordering, and derive parallel frontiers.
Keep all mechanics synchronous and static for V1.
excluded: Runtime scheduling, execution monitoring, or dynamic DAG mutation.

dependency-hints.rationale: Mechanics consume validated canonical graph artifacts.

checks.method: Exercise acyclic, cyclic, missing-reference, disconnected, and tie-order fixtures with randomized input ordering.
checks.successCriteria: Core returns a stable DAG, deterministic order and frontiers, or exact rejection diagnostics.

required-evidence.description: Core returns a stable DAG, deterministic order and frontiers, or exact rejection diagnostics.

workItems.objective: Implement the default native structured dependency proposer over the immutable candidate snapshot.

included: Propose typed ordering relationships and dispositions with deterministic source references.
Return proposals only through the proposal port.
excluded: Mutating Core graph state or declaring a proposal authoritative.

dependency-hints.rationale: Proposal consumes the exact candidate snapshot.

checks.method: Run proposal fixtures twice and compare normalized proposal bytes and source closure.
checks.successCriteria: The native proposer is deterministic, source-closed, and never receives graph mutation authority.

required-evidence.description: The native proposer is deterministic, source-closed, and never receives graph mutation authority.

workItems.objective: Evaluate dependency and hint-disposition policy through a version-pinned OPA boundary.

included: Define closed policy input and output contracts.
Bind policy bundle identity and normalize deterministic violations and dispositions.
excluded: Allowing Rego to mutate graph mechanics or invoke work execution.

deliverables.description: Versioned OPA policy bundle and evaluator boundary.

dependency-hints.rationale: Policy evaluates the normalized graph and declared hint dispositions.

checks.method: Evaluate pinned policy bundles against allow, deny, and malformed input fixtures.
checks.successCriteria: Policy decisions are content-addressed, deterministic, and cannot replace Core graph mechanics.

required-evidence.description: Policy decisions are content-addressed, deterministic, and cannot replace Core graph mechanics.

workItems.objective: Publish optional Task Master and OpenSpec proposal adapters behind the same bounded proposal port.

included: Normalize provider-native proposals into the canonical dependency proposal contract.
Declare exact capabilities and planning-only commands.
excluded: Making either optional adapter a Core dependency or execution engine.

deliverables.description: Optional Task Master and OpenSpec adapter manifests.

dependency-hints.rationale: Adapters must conform to the proposal port.

checks.method: Validate both manifests and normalize bounded provider fixtures through the shared port.
checks.successCriteria: Either adapter can be swapped without changing Core mechanics, policy, Gate, or output contracts.

required-evidence.description: Either adapter can be swapped without changing Core mechanics, policy, Gate, or output contracts.

workItems.objective: Build one immutable full candidate work-breakdown snapshot with relevant version-pinned context slices.

included: Bind the complete candidate work-item set and every relevant baseline, repository, and traceability context slice.
Reject incoherent or drifted context before proposal invocation.
excluded: Selecting dependency edges or policy outcomes.

dependency-hints.rationale: The snapshot must implement the canonical artifact contract; authority remains with WorkDependencyAnalysis.

checks.method: Replay identical inputs and mutate each pinned baseline, context slice, and repository identity.
checks.successCriteria: Identical inputs yield identical snapshots and every stale or incoherent binding is rejected before proposal.

required-evidence.description: Identical inputs yield identical snapshots and every stale or incoherent binding is rejected before proposal.

workItems.objective: Add Spec Kit as a consistency reviewer over the proposed dependency graph.

included: Review proposal consistency against the pinned candidate and context slices.
Return advisory findings through a bounded reviewer contract.
excluded: Creating authoritative edges or bypassing Core policy evaluation.

checks.method: Review valid and intentionally inconsistent proposal fixtures and verify advisory-only authority.
checks.successCriteria: Spec Kit findings are reproducible and cannot directly change the authoritative DAG.

required-evidence.description: Spec Kit findings are reproducible and cannot directly change the authoritative DAG.

workItems.objective: Project the authoritative dependency DAG into TraceabilityGraph through a trusted forward-only contributor.

included: Derive approved WorkItem-to-WorkItem dependency relationships from the Gate-approved DAG.
Persist graph version, update digest, execution identity, and resulting checkpoint.
excluded: Graph access or arbitrary relationship selection by proposal adapters.

deliverables.description: Trusted dependency traceability contributor and merge proof.

checks.method: Project, merge, replay, query, and inspect every approved dependency edge and merge receipt.
checks.successCriteria: The graph contains only trusted forward dependency edges with a reproducible atomic merge proof.

required-evidence.description: The graph contains only trusted forward dependency edges with a reproducible atomic merge proof.

workItems.objective: Release-gate WorkDependencyAnalysis across contracts, routing, proposals, Core mechanics, policy, Gate, traceability, and packaging.

included: Run focused and full regression, replay, drift, authority, determinism, and package checks.
Prove that optional proposal providers cannot change Core outcomes without explicit normalized input changes.
excluded: Executing any DAG work item or claiming downstream completion.

dependency-hints.rationale: Gate behavior must be available for end-to-end verification.
Traceability behavior must be available for end-to-end verification.

checks.method: Run the canonical package gate, module dogfood replay, mutation tests, and independent contract review.
checks.successCriteria: All release gates pass with deterministic outputs and no assignment, scheduling, or execution authority.

required-evidence.description: All release gates pass with deterministic outputs and no assignment, scheduling, or execution authority.
